scope: Dev13 development only; no Frozen V3 Test40 execution

common_downstream_pipeline.tagger_reasoning_effort: provider default, not explicitly set; identical across arms
common_downstream_pipeline.answer_reasoning_effort: provider default, not explicitly set; identical across arms

metric_boundary.primary_answer_metric: Davidson Bradley-Terry normalized ability from citation-blind adaptive mirrored pairwise judgments of scientific correctness and question fulfillment

pairwise_protocol.adaptive_rule: add one second mirrored pair only when the two initial system-mapped outcomes disagree
pairwise_protocol.uncertainty: question-cluster bootstrap with all three pair outcomes retained within each sampled question

primary_citation_metric.name: citation_supported_claim_rate
primary_citation_metric.definition: externally verifiable answer claims that are entailed by their immediately cited retrieved chunks divided by all externally verifiable answer claims

metric_boundary.citation_gold_recall_prohibited: Chunk gold is non-exhaustive and cannot define complete citation recall.

cost_boundary.tagger: common downstream cost reported separately for every arm
cost_boundary.answer_generation: common downstream cost reported separately for every arm
cost_boundary.bge_llm_selector: retrieval-specific cost assigned only to BGE-LLM

latency_boundary.per_call: wall-clock latency measured around every current-run tagger and answer API request
latency_boundary.per_system: sum and mean per-call latency reported separately for each system and stage
latency_boundary.parallel_stage: observed wall-clock duration of the interleaved tagger and answer stages
latency_boundary.retrieval: matched Hybrid, BGE, and BGE-LLM stage latency inherited from Frozen V3 runtime records with provenance
latency_boundary.aggregation_warning: summed per-call latency and parallel wall-clock are distinct quantities and must not be interchanged
